title: Kitagawa San Background
description: An anime-inspired background pack featuring clean aesthetics, soft colors, and a relaxing visual atmosphere for Minecraft’s menu screen.
body:
Kitagawa Background Pack is a beautifully designed anime-inspired background pack that enhances Minecraft’s menu screen with soft colors, clean visuals, and a smooth aesthetic style. Inspired by cozy and relaxing anime themes, the pack creates a calm and visually pleasing atmosphere every time the game is launched.

With its balanced composition and gentle color palette, the background blends naturally with Minecraft’s interface while adding a unique and stylish touch. The design focuses on simplicity and elegance, ensuring the visuals remain immersive without feeling distracting or overwhelming.

Perfect for players who enjoy cute aesthetics, anime-inspired visuals, and relaxing themes, Kitagawa Background Pack delivers a polished and refreshing look that gives Minecraft a more cozy and personalized feel. 🌸✨
